integrity: All integer-size identities are proved by the given weighted matrix-tree and occupancy argument; finite reproduction is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly random labeled unrooted trees and two fixed marked vertices are treated. Prior exact rooted-forest child-count polynomial is acknowledged; the originality claim concerns the sharp conditional optimization and stochastic nonordering. Historical priority remains subject to uninspected older papers.
title: A cubic distance scale for conditional leaf abundance in uniformly labeled trees
